headings.usage: H1, H2, large display texts. Use italic selectively for specific keywords to create editorial tension.

typography.fluid_typography: MUST use clamp() via Tailwind arbitrary values for responsive font sizing (e.g., text-[clamp(2rem,5vw,4.5rem)] for hero).
typography.hierarchy_gap_rule: Maintain 2 Tailwind steps between heading and subheadings.

colors.usage: Obsidian Black (60%) for backgrounds, Graphite Charcoal (30%) for surfaces/cards/borders. Champagne Gold (10%) sparingly for interactive highlights, active states, or subtle gradient lines. Ivory Off-White for high-contrast primary text.

visual_enhancers.borders: Subtle borders ONLY. 1px solid border-white/5 or border-[#1C1C1C].
visual_enhancers.radius: Tokenized consistent radius: rounded-none or very tight rounded-md (4px) to maintain sharp, premium editorial feel.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid dark surfaces. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdowns. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 for header.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture overlay on the main background to reduce digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12, py-24, py-32 for sections. Bento grid protocols for features.
grids_and_layouts.hero: Kinetic large hero. 100vh height. Masked line-by-line reveal for title.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: Asymmetric grids. Avoid perfectly equal squares. Mix tall, wide, and square cells. col-span-full md:col-span-8 etc.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align text blocks generally, avoid center-everything disease.

components.Button.jsx: 4 variants (primary, secondary, outline, ghost), 6 states (default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading). Champagne gold accents on hover.
components.Header.jsx: Sticky clean header. z-50. Solid or blurred background (never fully transparent over content). Accessible mobile menu.
components.Section.jsx: Wrapper for consistent padding and max-w-7xl constraint.
components.Card.jsx: Minimalist card with Graphite Charcoal background and 1px subtle border.
components.Input.jsx: Form inputs with distinct focus rings (ring-1 ring-[#D4AF37]), no default blue outlines.
components.Footer.jsx: Rich footer with massive bottom space and large brand typography.
components.ContactForm.jsx: Validation, honeypot, rate limit state, loading/success/error states.
components.CookieBanner.jsx: LGPD consent banner, bottom-fixed, dark themed.

motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle parallax / 3D moment in hero image overlay.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for services or partners (using react-fast-marquee).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactives must have clear hover states (slight color shift or transform).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA / WCAG AA minimums. Ivory on Obsidian is safe.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus states for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

media_and_images.treatment: Photography MUST be treated deliberately: cinematic spotlight, dark overlays, clipped frames, grayscale/desaturated.

images.description: Cinematic dark spotlight for abstract tech/AI feel.
Dark minimalist architecture. Needs grayscale or dark overlay.

3d_libraries.framer_motion: Core animation library for line-by-line reveals and scroll-triggered fade-ins.
3d_libraries.lenis: MANDATORY for smooth scrolling. Wrap main layout.
3d_libraries.react_spring: Optional for lightweight parallax, or stick to Framer Motion useScroll.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React files as .jsx (no TypeScript).
Ensure the hero has a dramatic masked text reveal on load.
Create the specific pages: Home, Services, Digital Experience, Artificial Intelligence, Contact, Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, Terms of Use, 404.
Sections to build but keep disabled/hidden (via a feature flag or commented out) for v1: Cases, Testimonials, Results/Numbers.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts. Only use Shadcn/custom React components for interactive elements like the Contact form.
Integrate the Contact Form with validation, honeypot, and clear loading/error/success UI.
Ensure pt-BR language settings and WCAG compliance.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT output generic 'AI slop'. Use deep, layered aesthetics.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as generic gradients.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Use p-8, p-12, py-24.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states (e.g. ::selection { bg-champagne-gold text-black }).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds for sticky headers. Always use solid or blurred backdrop.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not center-align everything; use optical alignment and structured grids.
Do not use generic emoji for icons; use high-quality icon libraries (lucide-react).
